notes: Release date printed on page: 2025/09/24 (Chinese version; English translation linked from same page). Blog migrated from qwenlm.github.io to qwen.ai - old slug qwenlm.github.io/blog/qwen3-max/ now 404s; captured via headless browser on qwen.ai. Four prose-printed scores verified (SWE-Bench Verified 69.6, Tau2-Bench 74.8, AIME 25 / HMMT 100% for the Thinking Heavy preview); remaining values render inside two chart images (Qwen3-Max-Instruct.png, Qwen3-Max-Thinking-blog.jpg) and one leaderboard screenshot, kept pending with vision-assisted reads in notes (goal.md 12.5). Qwen3-Max-Thinking was still in training at release - its rows are preview disclosures, and the AIME/HMMT 100% figures carry the with-tools + parallel-test-time-compute protocol in prose. Architecture notes: >1T total parameters, 36T pre-training tokens, global-batch load balancing loss, 1M long-context training supported via ChunkFlow.
